messages:
julia (Acme): hey @sam, after switching the model this morning our production job started returning invalid JSON for strict_json mode. getting type errors (numbers turned into strings, booleans quoted, enum casing flipped). can you help?

sam: thanks — can you paste a minimal repro (request + response) and the model/version you hit? also the request id if you have it.

julia (Acme): here you go (redacted):
```http
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-instruct-1@v1.5.0\",
  \"json_mode\": \"strict\",
  \"schema\": {
    \"type\": \"object\",
    \"properties\": {
      \"id\": {\"type\": \"number\"},
      \"active\": {\"type\": \"boolean\"},
      \"status\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"enum\": [\"active\", \"inactive\"]}
    },
    \"required\": [\"id\", \"active\", \"status\"]
  }
}
```
and this is what we received back (body parsed by our client):
```json
{
  "id": "12345",
  "active": "false",
  "status": "ACTIVE"
}
```
SDK error: StructuredOutputError: type mismatch for field 'id' (expected number, got string); 'active' expected boolean got string; 'status' enum mismatch (case). request id: req-0a1b2c3d

sam: ok repro looks clear. did this start right after the model tag update? are you on dedicated or hosted? any rate/latency anomalies?

julia (Acme): hosted. no latency spikes, just started failing ~03:15 UTC after we saw a model rollout.

emily: @sam tagging eng-runtime. we had a rollout for redwood-instruct-1@v1.5.0 on 2026-03-01 03:12 UTC that included small detokenization tweaks to reduce stray spaces. possible side effect: numeric tokens that previously were emitted as raw numbers are being wrapped in quotes in some templated outputs.

sam: thanks @emily. possible quick mitigations for the customer: 1) pin to previous model tag (redwood-instruct-1@v1.4.2) 2) set a lenient flag if available (e.g., json_coerce_numbers: true) 3) server-side post-process: if schema expects number and value is string matching /^\d+$/ parseInt.

tony: I'll open an internal incident and add priority-high — include model_version, route, request id (req-0a1b2c3d), and sample payload. recommend pinning for now and we'll roll back the detokenization tweak if regression confirmed.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: redwood-instruct-1@v1.5.0 rolled out at 2026-03-01T03:12:04Z to hosted pool-7.

emily: preliminary root cause hypothesis: the detokenizer change introduced a conditional that wraps certain numeric-like token sequences in quotes when adjacent token context looked like a string boundary. edge-case for strict JSON mode wasn't covered by our tests. plan: add unit/regression tests for json_mode=strict, add sanitizer that forces numeric serialization for schema-typed outputs, and ship a hotfix patch.

julia (Acme): thanks all — pinning to v1.4.2 now. please let us know when hotfix is out, req-0a1b2c3d is the failing request id. really appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:

sam: noted. escalated to eng-runtime with the trace and repro. will update this thread when we have the patch or ETA.

emily: ETA for hotfix: 6-12h, will post rollback/pin guidance and include regression tests in the PR.

julia (Acme): perfect — thanks!
